facts.fact: The local TV advertising market is projected to reach $7.66 billion, with growth in smaller markets.
facts.quote: The local TV advertising market is projected to reach $7.66 billion, with growth in smaller markets.

facts.fact: Global CTV ad spending is expected to hit $33.35 billion, a 16% jump in just one year.
facts.quote: Global CTV ad spending is expected to hit **$33.35 billion**, a **16%** jump in just one year.

facts.fact: The page states that 90% of US households have CTV access.

facts.fact: The page states that streaming accounts for 44.8% of all US TV viewing time, beating out both broadcast and cable.
facts.quote: streaming now accounts for **44.8%** of all TV viewing time, beating out both broadcast and cable.

facts.fact: The page projects CTV's share of traditional broadcast ad revenue to rise from 5.9% in 2020 to 44.7% by 2029.
facts.quote: CTV's slice of traditional broadcast ad revenue is projected to leap from just **5.9%** in 2020 to **44.7%** by 2029.

facts.fact: The page defines a Designated Market Area (DMA) as the defined area where local TV ads run on affiliate stations or regional cable channels.
facts.quote: your ad runs on local affiliate stations or regional cable channels inside a defined **Designated Market Area (DMA)**.

facts.fact: The page says that creating a professional-looking TV ad before modern tools could cost into the thousands of dollars.
facts.quote: Just creating a professional-looking ad could run into the thousands, and that was before you even thought about paying for placement.

facts.fact: Connected TV (CTV) CPMs generally fall between $15 and $35, according to the page.
facts.quote: You’ll generally see CPMs between **$15 and $35**.

facts.fact: Adwave states that a local business can launch a campaign for as little as $30 per day.

facts.fact: Adwave states that its typical CPMs fall between $15 and $35 (vendor's own figure, not an industry benchmark).

facts.fact: The page states that professional production of a single local TV spot often costs between $3,500 and $15,000 (no source is cited).

facts.fact: The page states that in a presidential election year, political ad spending can rise to over $173 billion, mostly on video ads (no source is cited).

facts.fact: The page says viewers give a TV ad about 3-5 seconds to hook them before attention drifts.
facts.quote: You’ve got about **3-5 seconds** to hook someone before their eyes drift back to their phone.

facts.fact: An infographic on the page shows 90% of households use Linear TV and 90% use CTV.
facts.quote: 90% of households use Linear TV and 90% use CTV.

facts.fact: Adwave states that platforms like Adwave were built for small business budgets, with campaigns starting for as little as $30 per day.

facts.fact: Adwave's page says a simple local TV spot has historically cost between $3,500 and $15,000 to produce; this is the page's general claim, not an Adwave-sourced figure.
